project: 1967 Ford Mustang Fastback (`e-Mustang`) - 1:20 Printable RC & Gemini AI Studio

plates.title: Plate 1 - Fastback Body & Tinted Glass Inlays
plates.notes: Multi-colour assembled print (`body.stl` + `windshield.stl` + `rear_glass.stl`) with `tree(auto)` build-plate supports.

plates.title: Plate 2 - Hinged Hood & Trunk Lid
plates.notes: Dedicated plate so `tree(auto)` supports never crowd neighbouring parts.

plates.title: Plate 3 - Hinged Doors (+ Roof Pod in AI Edition)
plates.notes: Doors print flat on their inner face (`0` supports); AI Edition adds support-free `waymo_pod.stl`.

plates.title: Plate 4 - Structural Chassis, Tubs, Tires & Steering
plates.notes: 100% support-free structural plate with `outer_only` brims on slender steering and trim parts.

plates.title: Plate 5 - Torq-Thrust Rims, Front Bumper & Driveshaft
plates.notes: Support-free silver plate; `driveshaft.stl` prints flat horizontally on `Z = 0` for axial fiber strength.

plates.title: Plate 6 - Precision Bevel Gears, Couplers & Chrome Trim
plates.notes: Isolated low-Z precision plate (`<= 10.04 mm`) with `outer_only` brims and gentle `20-25 mm/s` speeds; AI adds `gc9a01_bezel.stl`.

plates.title: Plate 7 - Swept Rear Chrome Bumper
plates.notes: Dedicated plate standing upright on `tree(auto)` supports.

plates.title: Plate 9 - 289 V8 Motor Shroud Block
plates.notes: Hollowed underside cavity (`Engine_N25Cavity`) disguising the `N25` gearmotor on `324.45 mm^2` flat bed rails.

stages_rc.title: Fastback Shell & Multi-Colour Glass Inlays
stages_rc.summary: Print `body.stl` with flush black `windshield.stl` and `rear_glass.stl` inlays in one multi-colour job on Plate 1.
bullets: Lofted from 1967 Mustang station tables at `1:20` scale (`226 x 91 x 66 mm`).
Zero hand-sculpted polygons: every louver, V-prow crease, and recess is procedural Python CAD.

stages_rc.title: Twin-Cowl Cabin & Front Bay Liners
stages_rc.summary: Plug `SteeringWheel` into the 5-pod twin-cowl dash, then push `InteriorTub` and `BayTub` straight up (`+Z`) into `Body`.
bullets: Open-bottom `45°` gable shaft tunnels allow drop-in bottom-up driveshaft installation.
Dedicated driver-side wire conduit (`4.0 x 5.05 mm`) isolates wiring from the spinning shaft.

stages_rc.title: Motor, Servo, Conduit & Open-Bottom Driveshaft
stages_rc.summary: Seat the front `1.7g` servo and `N25` gearmotor (+ Z-shims & multi-fit `MotorCoupler`), thread the floor conduit, and lift `Driveshaft + PinionGear` (`7T`) into the open-bottom U-channel.
bullets: 4 indexed couplers on Plate 6 fit `Ø 1.0 mm`, `Ø 1.5 mm`, silicone sleeve, or `Ø 3.0 mm` N25 D-shafts.
Horizontal bed-flat octagonal `Driveshaft` (`+63%` torsional stiffness) prints with zero supports.

stages_rc.title: Filament-Core Kingpins, 9T Live Axle & Wheels
stages_rc.summary: Slide `1.75 mm` PLA filament cores into `Chassis` kingpins, snap `Knuckle_L/R` + `SteeringLink`, thread the `3.60 mm` octagonal `Axle_R` through `AxleGear` (`9T`) + `DiffCover`, and hand-slide the 4 `6`-key tires onto the rims.
bullets: `7.5 mm` snips of raw `1.75 mm` filament inside `Ø 2.60 mm` kingpins give `> 8x` shear strength.
Zero-undercut `6`-key tires slide onto reinforced `1.80 mm`-lip Torq-Thrust rims by hand.

stages_rc.title: Straight +Z Rolling Chassis Marriage
stages_rc.summary: Push the complete rolling `Chassis` straight up (`+Z`) onto `Body`: 9 mortise-and-tenon bosses lock `BayTub` and `InteriorTub`, `PinionGear` (`7T`) meshes at `90°` with `AxleGear` (`9T`), and the servo horn engages `SteeringLink`.
bullets: Kingpin top tips seat `1.30 mm` deep into `Body` sockets for true double-shear support.
Collared `7T:9T` bevel differential transfers smooth forward & reverse torque to the live rear axle.

stages_rc.title: 289 V8 Motor Shroud & Rear Electronics Deck
stages_rc.summary: Lower the hollowed Ford-blue 289 `EngineBlock` (+ Cobra valve covers & air cleaner) straight down (`-Z`) over the `N25` motor, and install `BootTub` + rear power/control modules in the trunk.
bullets: `EngineBlock` completely disguises the electric motor with `0.45 mm` vertical booster clearance.
Classic RC houses `2.4GHz Rx + 5A ESC + LiPo` (or 4-wire keyfob); AI Edition mounts the 2-story `Radxa Zero 3W` deck.

stages_rc.title: 1.75 mm Filament Door Hinges, Chrome & Panels
stages_rc.summary: Snap chrome bumpers, grille, and tri-bar taillights onto `Body`, interlock `DoorVent` + `DoorCard` into `Door_L/R` on `1.75 mm` filament hinge pins, and seat `Hood` (`+42°`) & `TrunkLid` (`-40°`).
bullets: `Ø 1.84 mm` sill press bore + `Ø 2.00 mm` door bore turn raw `1.75 mm` filament into crisp `+55°` door hinges.
Car is now 100% assembled and ready to steer, spin gears, and open all 4 hinged panels!
